verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native access review workflow that reminds you to start reviews on your policy's timelines, lets you validate access changes before finishing a review, and automates evidence gathering for audits ("when applicable"). Head Start and consecutive-review automation reuse prior reviews and focus on changes since the last one. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reviews pull user lists from connected apps or integrations, explicit reviewer sign-off or attestation in-app, confirmation that the completed artifact lands in the evidence library rather than only "when applicable," and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
